verdict: Afterglow is held with real discipline: one typeface, ember used only as light and the fluff squiggle, a distinctive hooked-h wordmark carried from nav to app icon to the edge-lit footer, and X-dark cards that feel native to the audience. It stops just short of best-in-class because the white pill, the brand's primary-action signal, is spent on buttons inside the mock-ups, and two photographic moments read softer than the pin-sharp UI around them.
to_95: Reserve the white pill for the page's own actions (Start free, Sharpen, Start with Pro, Sharpen every post free). Restyle the in-mock buttons 'Put it back', 'Reply' and 'Approve with my edit' as frosted pills so each screen has one white target.

Make the sunrise photo in the 'Say it at 11 PM' panel and the lock-screen backdrop look intentionally soft: reduce the rendered crop so the 800px sprite is not upscaled, and add the same fine grain plus a darker ember-tinted grade used in the hero beam.

Break the two-tone heading formula once or twice (all eleven headings are white line one, grey line two) so the big section headings feel authored rather than templated, for example all-white on 'Sharpening is free. Forever.'

issues.where: Voice panel ('Put it back'), Reply panel ('Reply'), Studio panel ('Approve with my edit'), at 1440 and 390
issues.problem: The white pill is the brand's primary-action signal, yet three mock-internal buttons use it at the same size and weight as the real CTAs. At 390 'Approve with my edit' sits one thumb above the sticky white 'Start free' bar, so two identical white pills compete and the visitor cannot tell which one is the page's.
issues.fix: Switch those three in-mock buttons to the frosted pill (glass fill, hairline border, soft-white label). Keep white pill only for Start free, Sharpen, Sharpen every post free and Start with Pro.

issues.where: 'Say it at 11 PM. Post it at 8:40 AM.' panel, right half at 1440; lock-screen card in 'Know what landed'
issues.problem: The sunrise skyline is upscaled from the 800px sprite and reads soft next to crisp type and hairlines; the softness looks like a resolution limit rather than a choice.
issues.fix: Render the crop at or below its native pixel size (narrow the photo column or mask it to the area behind the phone), then add a 3 to 4 percent grain overlay and a darker bottom gradient so the blur reads as depth of field.

issues.problem: All eleven headings use the same white-first-line, grey-second-line split. As a signature it works, but with no exception it starts to feel like a template by the pricing section.
issues.fix: Set 'Sharpening is free. Forever.' fully in soft white (or grey only on 'Forever.' as now but on one line at 1440), and keep the split for bento headings.

issues.problem: Under the heading and email line the left column is empty for about 250px while seven questions run on the right; it is the one place on the page with no brand presence.
issues.fix: Make the left column sticky within the section and add a single struck-fluff line as a quiet motif (for example a small draft line with one ember squiggle), or vertically centre the heading block against the list.

issues.where: Try box example chips at 390 ('Announcem...' cut at the card edge)
issues.problem: The chip row is clipped hard at the panel edge with no fade, which looks like an overflow bug rather than a scrollable row.
issues.fix: Add a 24px right-edge mask fade on the chip scroller (mask-image linear-gradient) so the cut reads as scrollable.
